name: Axis-Aligned Plane Intersection
definition: Intersects a ray with an axis-aligned plane defined by an anchor point, extent, and direction index `d`. Returns intersection distance `t` and barycentric-like coordinates `u, v`.
summary: Axis-Aligned Plane Intersection computes ray-plane hits using a direction index to permute axes, enabling a single implementation to handle all six faces of an axis-aligned bounding box without branching.
